text: Korea's 20% crypto capital gains tax, first legislated for 2022, has been pushed back three times and now starts Jan 2027 if the current bill holds. The exemption line is 2.5 million KRW a year in gains, about $1,800, everything above that gets taxed as other income with no offset for losses across tax years. Each delay came right before an election, which tells you more about the politics than the tax policy.
